definitions.explanation: Hair that is silver or gray in color. Can describe naturally grayed hair in an elegant or positive way, or silver-colored hair in fiction and character descriptions.

examples.japanese: {銀髪|ぎんぱつ}の{紳士|しんし}が{入|はい}ってきた。
{祖父|そふ}は{美|うつく}しい{銀髪|ぎんぱつ}をしている。
examples.english: My grandfather has beautiful silver hair.

examples.japanese: その{映画|えいが}の{主人公|しゅじんこう}は{銀髪|ぎんぱつ}に{赤|あか}い{目|め}という{印象的|いんしょうてき}な{外見|がいけん}だ。
examples.english: The protagonist of that movie has a striking appearance with silver hair and red eyes.

notes:
{銀髪|ぎんぱつ} has a more elegant or attractive connotation than {白髪|しらが} (white/gray hair), which is a neutral or sometimes negative term for aging hair. {銀髪|ぎんぱつ} is also very common in anime and manga character descriptions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {銀髪|ぎんぱつ}の{男性|だんせい} (silver-haired man)
- {美|うつく}しい{銀髪|ぎんぱつ} (beautiful silver hair)
- {銀髪|ぎんぱつ}キャラ (silver-haired character)
